title: 113. Letter Combinations of a Phone Number

examples.explanation: Digits '2' and '3' map to ['abc', 'def'] respectively. There are 9 total letter combinations: ["ad","ae","af","bd","be","bf","cd","ce","cf"].
Each digit "7" maps to ['pqrs']. There are 4 total letter combinations: ["p","q","r","s"].
Each digit "2" maps to ['abc']. There are 3 total letter combinations: ["a","b","c"].

hints: Associate each digit with its keypad letters.
Backtrack through the digits, appending one mapped letter at each position.
